items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I'm talking about the one that John's playing. I'm trying to get him in this outfit that I'm getting together now on the bass. Well I take a few lessons from his brother Willie. Yeah, he's good. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Clannett, he played Clannett in sax. That's Kaiser.

ctx.x: Well no, because Willie plays clarinet.

Willie plays clarinet. Well they're father. I think his was Willie too. Yeah. The old man was named Willie. Well Willie plays clarinet and one brother plays trumpet. Percy. Percy, yeah. Well I studied a while under their father. He was a good musician too. He's taught me. He's still alive. Yeah.
